name: Lightning Greaves
description: Greaves forged from steel made of ore on cliffs struck by lightning.

timeline.summary: Lightning strikes cliffs, turning ore to iron and steel and forging the Lightning Greaves.
timeline.quote: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves.
